integrity: Unrestricted proof through explicit elementary collapses and a two-disk cellular model; finite exhaustive graph verification corroborates but does not establish the theorem. No independent mathematical validation claimed.
limitations: Only finite connected triangle-free graphs whose every four-cycle is edge-disjoint from every other four-cycle; the nontrivial claim covers at least one square. Nonequivariant wedge decomposition; only natural integral homology modules are asserted for automorphisms. No classification for overlapping squares or triangles.
title: Square-localized spheres in closed-neighborhood complexes of triangle-free graphs
